_comment: Campaign-level alerts from the WEEKLY deep scan (pacing, budget caps, zero-conversion campaigns, non-delivery). These need per-campaign data that is too large to pull daily, so they refresh weekly. The evaluator merges these with the daily account-level alerts.

alerts.title: Campaign spending with zero conversions
alerts.detail: '2022-Heriz Gallery - Search - Competitor - Phrase' spent R2,957.97 over 30 days with 0 conversions (1,019 clicks). Competitor-term traffic is not converting.
alerts.action: Review search terms / landing page or pause the competitor campaign.

alerts.title: Campaign CPA far above account average
alerts.detail: 'Furniture-Performance Max | 13-05-2026' converting at R741 CPA vs the account's best at ~R16 (≈45×). R1,824 for 2.46 conversions.
alerts.action: Check PMax asset group / signals and conversion tracking; lower budget until CPA stabilises.

alerts.title: High CPA on Refurbished Rugs
alerts.detail: 'Refurbished Rugs | Search | 30-1-26' spent R3,001 for 6.23 conversions (R481 CPA) — well above the R16 generic campaign.
alerts.action: Tighten match types/negatives or reallocate to the BOF generic campaign.

alerts.title: Budget-constrained (scaling opportunity)
alerts.detail: 'Search - Brand (R6000)' runs at ~R247/day vs a R250 cap (99%) at a strong R50 CPA (148 conversions) — likely leaving converting traffic on the table.

alerts.title: Budget-constrained at higher CPA
alerts.detail: 'Search - New Vehicles (R9000)' runs at ~R235/day vs a R236 cap (99%) but at R261 CPA (27 conversions). Capped, but weaker efficiency than Brand.

alerts.title: Active campaign not delivering
alerts.detail: 'Rola Toyota Bredasdorp Giveaway_Awareness_April_1000' recorded 0 impressions and R0 spend over 30 days while appearing live.
alerts.action: Check campaign status, schedule and budget; archive if intentionally off.

alerts.title: Enabled experiment with no impressions
alerts.detail: 'Search - Brand (R7,500) Experiment' is ENABLED but recorded 0 impressions — experiment may not be serving or the split is misconfigured.
alerts.action: Verify the experiment schedule and traffic split.
